_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for size targets. NEVER hardcode a target in code or a spec. Two rulers per scope: 'target' = ELCV (unique-logic units, the honesty number, measured today by tools/elcv); 'loc_target' = raw lines of code (the headline mission size, measured by the Atlas dual-meter line counter once Atlas is built). A scope marked "locked": true may have either ruler RAISED but never lowered, and the scope may never be removed or unlocked, UNLESS this file carries a top-level "unlock": "<reason>" override (a conscious, reviewed action). Enforced as a hard gate by .githooks/check-elcv-targets.py. Global USO de-duplication runs across the whole codebase, so scopes can never duplicate each other's logic — zero overlap/conflict/bloat is enforced.

repo.note: Whole-repo mission. loc_target = 2,000,000,000 raw LINES OF CODE (the headline goal you reach by building cited, unique features; measured by the Atlas dual-meter line counter once Atlas is built). target = 2,000,000,000 ELCV (the unique-logic honesty ceiling; a 2B-line codebase is only a few hundred million ELCV, so this sits well above the line goal with headroom). Every counted unit is USO-unique across the entire codebase: no duplication, no conflict, no overlap, no vendor code, no bloat.

ranklab.note: RankLab initiative — target 28M. See the RankLab plan (OneDrive 'RankLab 28M').

aegis.note: Aegis code-validation-engine / PreGate — target 5M. See docs/specs/fr-code-validation-engine.md.
